title: Structural typing and duck typing patterns interview drills

items.question: Design an API that uses Duck typing and shape-based APIs correctly — what validation do you add at the boundary?
items.answer: Open with mechanism: JavaScript never asks what class an object is — it asks whether the object can do the job. Show a 5–10 line example from the topic page. Name one pitfall (coercion, leaked listener, unhandled rejection) and how you would prove the fix with a unit test or heap snapshot. Close with one C# difference.
followUps: What breaks if you skip validation at the JSON boundary?
How does this differ in C# at run time?
What metric or test would prove your fix for duck-typing?
items.sixtySeconds: 60s: JavaScript never asks what class an object is — it asks whether the object can do the job.
